heading: Health professions workforce information and analysis

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: It is the purpose of this section to—

children.text: provide for the development of information describing the health professions workforce and the analysis of workforce related issues; and
provide necessary information for decision-making regarding future directions in health professions and nursing programs in response to societal and professional needs.

tree.heading: National Center for Health Care Workforce Analysis

children.heading: Establishment
children.text: The Secretary shall establish the National Center for Health Workforce Analysis (referred to in this section as the “National Center”).

children.heading: Purposes
children.text: The National Center, in coordination to the extent practicable with the National Health Care Workforce Commission (established in section 294q of this title), and relevant regional and State centers and agencies, shall—
provide for the development of information describing and analyzing the health care workforce and workforce related issues;
carry out the activities under section 295k(a) of this title;
annually evaluate programs under this subchapter;
develop and publish performance measures and benchmarks for programs under this subchapter; and

establish, maintain, and publicize a national Internet registry of each grant awarded under this subchapter and a database to collect data from longitudinal evaluations (as described in subsection (d)(2)) on performance measures (as developed under sections 293l(d)(3), 294f(d)(3), and 294o(a)(3) of this title).

children.heading: In general
children.text: The National Center shall collaborate with Federal agencies and relevant professional and educational organizations or societies for the purpose of linking data regarding grants awarded under this subchapter.

children.heading: Contracts for health workforce analysis
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out the activities described in subparagraph (A), the National Center may enter into contracts with relevant professional and educational organizations or societies.

tree.heading: State and regional Centers for Health Workforce Analysis

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary shall award grants to, or enter into contracts with, eligible entities for purposes of—
collecting, analyzing, and reporting data regarding programs under this subchapter to the National Center and to the public; and
providing technical assistance to local and regional entities on the collection, analysis, and reporting of data.

children.heading: Eligible entities
children.text: To be eligible for a grant or contract under this subsection, an entity shall—
be a State, a State workforce investment board, a public health or health professions school, an academic health center, or an appropriate public or private nonprofit entity; and
submit to the Secretary an application at such time, in such manner, and containing such information as the Secretary may require.

tree.heading: Increase in grants for longitudinal evaluations

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary shall increase the amount awarded to an eligible entity under this subchapter for a longitudinal evaluation of individuals who have received education, training, or financial assistance from programs under this subchapter.

children.heading: Capability
children.text: A longitudinal evaluation shall be capable of—
studying practice patterns; and
collecting and reporting data on performance measures developed under sections 293l(d)(3), 294f(d)(3), and 294o(a)(3) of this title.

children.heading: Guidelines
children.text: A longitudinal evaluation shall comply with guidelines issued under sections 293l(d)(4), 294f(d)(4), and 294o(a)(4) of this title.

children.heading: Eligible entities
children.text: To be eligible to obtain an increase under this section, an entity shall be a recipient of a grant or contract under this subchapter.

children.heading: National Center
children.text: To carry out subsection (b), there are authorized to be appropriated $5,663,000 for each of fiscal years 2021 through 2025.

children.heading: State and regional Centers
children.text: To carry out subsection (c), there are authorized to be appropriated $4,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2010 through 2014.

children.heading: Grants for longitudinal evaluations
children.text: To carry out subsection (d), there are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary for fiscal years 2010 through 2014.

children.heading: Reservation
children.text: Of the amounts appropriated under paragraph (1) for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall reserve not less than $600,000 for conducting health professions research and for carrying out data collection and analysis in accordance with section 295k of this title.

children.heading: Availability of additional funds
children.text: Amounts otherwise appropriated for programs or activities under this subchapter may be used for activities under subsection (b) with respect to the programs or activities from which such amounts were made available.

notes.heading: Transfer of Functions
notes.text: Pub. L. 111–148, title V, § 5103(b), Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 605, provided that: “Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act [Mar. 23, 2010], the responsibilities and resources of the National Center for Health Workforce Analysis, as in effect on the date before the date of enactment of this Act, shall be transferred to the National Center for Health Care Workforce Analysis established under section 761 of the Public Health Service Act [42 U.S.C. 294n], as amended by subsection (a).”
